items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: We played in the Mardi Gras parade. We had two bands together.

ctx.x: I believe yesterday or this morning. I don't know.

Yesterday. Since lately we were speaking about it. Sitting out on Aunt Gary. You couldn't take it away from him. I see they're proud of him. Yeah. We played in the Mardi Gras parade. We had two bands together. See?
Poor fellow when he got that stroke.
